question.prompt: On a number line, point A represents -3, point B is to the right of the origin, and the distance between A and B is 5. What number is represented by the midpoint of segment AB? (Write your answer as a fraction in simplest form or a decimal.)

solutions.explanation: B is to the right of the origin, so it represents \(-3+5=2\). The midpoint represents \((-3+2)\div2=-1/2\).
solutions.title: Average the endpoint coordinates

solutions.explanation: Since \(A\) represents \(-3\) and \(B\) lies to the right of the origin, \(B\) is to the right of \(A\). The midpoint lies halfway along the segment, so it is \(5\div2=2.5\) units to the right of \(A\). Its coordinate is therefore \(-3+2.5=-0.5=-\frac12\).
solutions.title: Move halfway along the segment
